headerDisplay: Exposes RainMachine sprinkler zones as HomeKit valves, talking directly to the controller's local API (no cloud).

address.title: RainMachine Address
address.description: Local API address of your RainMachine, e.g. rainmachine.local, rainmachine.local:8080, or the full https://rainmachine.local:8080/api/4.

ignoreInactiveZones.title: Ignore inactive zones
ignoreInactiveZones.description: Only show zones that are enabled/active on the RainMachine controller. Uncheck to also expose disabled zones.

pollInterval.title: Poll Interval (seconds)
pollInterval.description: How often to refresh zone state and active/inactive status from the controller.

defaultRunTime.title: Default Run Time (seconds)
defaultRunTime.description: Default watering duration used when a zone is turned on without an explicit duration set in the Home app.
